_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
Surround ya {num_players}-Bakinnyi kuri gridi ya {width}x{height}.
Ni wowe mukinnyi {player_id}. Ibikorwa byemewe ni: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' cyangwa w/s/a/d.
Ingenzi: kubaho kurenga abandi. Amatembero ni ya kuyobya; kugonga kwa muduko ni icumu; gukandagira kwa mutwe ni icumu kwa bombi.

game_action.invalid_death: Umukinnyi {player_id} yapfuye kubera ko yari afite umukino udakwiriye.

outcome.turn_limit: Iyo ugeze ku mupaka w'aho ushobora guhindukira, uwarokotse igihe kirekire kurusha abandi ni we utsinda.
